source_of_truth_hierarchy: 4. Markdown report derived from canonical results (phase10a_final_report.md)

E2.discrepancy_note: The previous Markdown draft text contained a copy-paste string naming 'all-mpnet-base-v2'. The actual execution, embedding matrices, and raw JSON outputs strictly used 'intfloat/e5-small-v2' (384-dim).

discrepancy_records.description: Discrepancy between Markdown text ('all-mpnet-base-v2') and canonical JSON ('intfloat/e5-small-v2')
discrepancy_records.resolution_reason: Execution logs and model weights verify intfloat/e5-small-v2 (384-dim) with passage/query prefixes was actually executed.

discrepancy_records.description: Discrepancy in reported C15 dense rank under condition A1-E0
discrepancy_records.corrected_value: Rank #95 (in raw execution JSON and CSV)
discrepancy_records.resolution_reason: Raw execution dense similarity matrix places C15 at exact 1-indexed rank #95 under A1-E0. The summary text #83 was an erroneous manual transcription.

discrepancy_records.description: Blanket claim that C147 remains stable at rank #4-#6 across all conditions
discrepancy_records.corrected_value: Under E1 (bge-small-en-v1.5) with A2/A3, C147 dense rank regresses to #35 and #31.
discrepancy_records.resolution_reason: Empirical evidence shows C147 rank drops from #6 to #35 under A2-E1 and #31 under A3-E1. The claim was corrected to report exact per-condition movements.

discrepancy_records.description: Global claim of 'zero regression' across the benchmark
discrepancy_records.corrected_value: Q05 Final Recall drops to 0% under A1-E0 and A0-E1; Q03 Final Recall drops to 0% under A3-E1; Q06 drops to 50% under A1-E0.
discrepancy_records.resolution_reason: Removed blanket zero-regression statement and replaced with explicit per-question regression analysis.

discrepancy_records.description: Conflicting statements on Gate C status (Triggered vs Conditional Pass)
discrepancy_records.corrected_value: Gate C NO TRIGGER / CONDITIONAL PASS. Condition A1-E1 achieved 95.0% Candidate Recall and recovered C42 to Rank #2 inside Candidate N=20.
discrepancy_records.resolution_reason: Re-evaluated Gate C against canonical metrics. Because A1-E1 successfully recovered C42 into Candidate N=20 and boosted Candidate Recall to 95.0%, fine-tuning is not triggered at Phase 10A.

Gate_A_Representation.finding: Metadata enrichment (A1) improves C15 #142 -> #95 and C42 #99 -> #67 under E0.

Gate_B_Embedding.finding: Condition A1-E1 achieves 95.0% Candidate Recall@20 and recovers C42 into Candidate N=20 at Rank #2.

Gate_C_FineTuning.finding: Fine-tuning is not required for Phase 10A because A1-E1 achieved 95.0% Candidate Recall and recovered C42.
